TheActing IVIayor opened the Public Hearing for Bylaws No. 1852 and 1853 at 5:35pm,and read a statement
to inform those present of the public hearing procedure.

Director of Planning Matthew Baldwin advised that Jared Steingard of Westbrook Consulting has applied on
behalf ofthe property owners ofStrata Plan VIS1876 to amend the Official Community Plan Designation of
1000 Citation Road and 2961 Secretariat Way from Neighbourhood to Mixed-Use Employment Centre and
to amend the zoning of 1000 Citation Road from the R2 (One- and Two-Family Residential) Zone to the
RM2A (Attached Housing) Zone and to amend the zoning of 2961 Secretariat Way from the R2 (One- and
Two-Family Residential) to the RM7A (Medium Density Apartment) Zone.

This is being proposed in order to allow for the development of approximately 12townhouse units at 1000
Citation Road and approximately 76 apartment units at 2961 Secretariat Way.

As part of this application, a public hearing is required in accordance with the regulations of the Local
Government Act.


In support of this application, the applicant has agreedto provide the following:

1. That the applicant provides, as a bonus forincreased density, the following contributions per residential
     unit, prior to issuance of a building permit:
              a) $610 towards the Affordable Housing Fund; and
              b) $3,660 towards the General Amenity Fund.
     The apartment component may besubject to reductions depending onthe use and height in accordance
     with the Affordable Housing and Amenity Contribution Policy

2. That the applicant provides, priorto Public Hearing, the following:
         a) Atechnical memo from an engineer that verifies Stormwater can be adequately managed on-
            siteforthe proposed developments, to the satisfaction ofthe Director of Engineering;
         b) Conceptual design drawings for both 1000 Citation Road and 2691 Secretariat Way to the
              satisfaction of the Director of Planning.

3. The applicant provides, prior to Bylaw Adoption, a Section 219 covenant, registered in priority of all
     other charges on title, that agrees to the following:
         a) That all frontage improvements to Bylaw No. 1000standards are provided to the satisfaction of
            the Director of Engineering prior to the issuance of a building permit, including any required
            measures from the Traffic Impact Study;
         b) Complete remaining sidewalk on Citation Road to Florence Lake Road to the satisfaction of the
              Director of Engineering;

        f)   That the 6 m portion that will remain of road will be improved to the satisfaction of the Fire

Council has directed Staff to complete the following;
    1. Amend Schedule "Al" within the Zoning Bylaw No. 300 to include 2691 Secretariat Way; and
